name: Aegon I Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The founder of the Targaryen dynasty. Aegon, riding the black dragon Balerion, conquered and unified six of the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros.

timeline.event: Crowned at Oldtown, Aegon establishes his capital at King's Landing and begins building the kingdom.

name: Visenya Targaryen
description: The elder sister-wife of Aegon I. A fierce warrior, she rode the dragon Vhagar, wielded the Valyrian steel sword Dark Sister, and oversaw the conquest of the Vale.

timeline.event: Assists Aegon in administration and designs the Kingsguard protection.

name: Rhaenys Targaryen
description: The younger, more playful sister-wife of Aegon I. She rode the dragon Meraxes, loved music and poetry, and helped win the Stormlands.

timeline.event: Patronizes singers and fosters diplomatic ties across the realm.

name: Orys Baratheon
description: Aegon's close friend and rumored half-brother. Orys slew King Argilac, married his daughter Argella, and became the first Hand of the King and founder of House Baratheon.

timeline.event: Rules the Stormlands from Storm's End and serves as Aegon's primary commander.

name: Torrhen Stark
description: The last King in the North. Torrhen Stark marched a large army south to fight Aegon but bent the knee after seeing the scale of Targaryen forces and dragons.

timeline.event: Enforces the peace of the Dragon in the North, facing some political backlash from his brothers.

name: Loren I Lannister
description: The last King of the Rock. He allied with Mern Gardener to fight Aegon on the Field of Fire, escaped the blaze, submitted, and was named Warden of the West.

timeline.event: Integrates the Westerlands into the royal economy, resuming gold flow.

name: Edmyn Tully
description: The first Tully Lord Paramount. Edmyn led the Riverlands rebellion against King Harren the Black, swearing fealty to Aegon before Harrenhal burned.

timeline.event: Accepts fealty from the other river lords, pacifying the central kingdoms.

name: Harlan Tyrell
description: The high steward of Highgarden who yielded the castle to Aegon after House Gardener was extinguished. Aegon rewarded his surrender with the castle and rule of the Reach.

timeline.event: Consolidates his rule over the Reach, facing coldness from Florents and Oakhearts.

name: Ronnel Arryn
description: The boy king who surrendered the Vale. When Queen Visenya flew Vhagar to the Eyrie, Ronnel was found sitting on her lap, asking if he could ride the dragon.

timeline.event: Ronnel rules the Vale under the regency of his mother, Sharra Arryn.

name: Sharra Arryn
description: The regent who ruled the Vale for her young son Ronnel. Known as the 'Flower of the Vale', she submitted after Visenya flew over their defenses.

timeline.event: Assists her son in governing the mountain clans and sea ports.

name: Vickon Greyjoy
description: The first Greyjoy ruler of the Iron Islands. Vickon was elected by the ironborn lords in 2 AC after Aegon executed the remaining Hoares.

timeline.event: Appointed by election, Vickon enforces royal laws and discourages reaving.

name: Meria Martell
description: The eighty-year-old, blind ruler of Dorne who resisted Aegon. She told Rhaenys that Dorne would fight and refuse to bend, successfully holding off the dragons.

timeline.event: Refuses Rhaenys' terms of surrender, declaring Dorne will stay sovereign.

name: Daemon Velaryon
description: Aegon's first Master of Ships. He commanded the fleet during the conquest and was slain by Arryn forces at the battle in Gulltown harbor.

timeline.event: Slain in the Gulltown naval combat.

name: Crispian Celtigar
description: A Valyrian nobleman who served as Aegon's first Master of Coin, establishing the realm's taxation and treasury systems.

timeline.event: Manages treasury operations and taxes for the newly unified Seven Kingdoms.
